usdRate.note: Market rate on 30 Oct 2026; the World Bank 2024 average was 24,165. SBV central rate page is script-rendered.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: National Statistics Office (Ministry of Finance), CPI October 2026
inflation_cpi.note: CPI up 5.09% on October 2025; 10-month average 4.57%, core inflation 4.24%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: NSO CPI October 2026 (10-month average 4.57%, core 4.24%); World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG (3.3% in 2025)
inflation_projection.note: We plan with 4.5%, between the 3.3% of 2025 and the 4.6% 10-month average of 2026, close to core inflation.

policy_rate.sourceName: State Bank of Vietnam refinancing rate (via Trading Economics)
policy_rate.note: Refinancing rate 4.50% (reference period October 2026, unchanged); SBV site is script-rendered, so a secondary source is used.

savings_account_rate.note: Rate removed: the only readable figure was one bank's own rate sheet, which we do not cite; SBV publishes no readable average for demand deposits (its site is script-rendered).

fdr_3m_rate.note: Rate removed: the only readable figure was one bank's own rate sheet, which we do not cite; SBV publishes no readable average for this term (its site is script-rendered).

fdr_1y_rate.note: Rate removed: the only readable figure was one bank's own rate sheet, which we do not cite; SBV publishes no readable average for this term (its site is script-rendered).

dps_rate.note: Banks sell accumulative savings plans with monthly deposits (tiết kiệm tích lũy), but we could not read a published rate (bank pages are script-rendered).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 4.78% for 2023, the latest World Bank value; older than 2025, so treat as dated.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Vietnam has no government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The State Treasury rarely issues treasury bills and no current 91-day yield is published.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No readable published 5-year government bond yield found (HNX and bond yield pages are script-rendered).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Vietnam 10-year government bond yield

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Vietnam individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on deposits with credit institutions and banks is non-taxable income.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No savings certificate exists; PwC lists investment income (interest) as taxable but does not say how government bond interest is treated.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Insurance of Vietnam (DIV), article on the Deposit Insurance Law 2025
deposit_insurance_limit.note: VND 350 million per depositor per insured institution, principal and interest, raised from VND 125 million alongside the Deposit Insurance Law 2025 (in force 1 May 2026); the article does not give the exact start date of the new limit.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap on credit card rates and no published typical rate found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: VN-Index record (Trading Economics); safe rate about 4.5%
equity_return_low.note: The VN-Index is volatile, so the low case is just under the safe rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate about 4.5% (SBV refinancing rate, 10-year bond 4.58%) plus an equity premium
equity_return_base.note: Base case 4 points above the 4.5% safe rate, the most allowed, given a strong but volatile 10-year index record.

equity_return_high.note: High case if the market keeps its long-run growth and earns an emerging-market upgrade.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; USD/VND trend (Trading Economics)
gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall for a decade, and local gold bar prices carry a premium that can shrink.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; USD/VND trend (Trading Economics)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% plus about 2% a year of dong depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; USD/VND trend (Trading Economics)
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle and faster dong depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: SBV refinancing rate; short-term deposit rates below the policy rate
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case for short deposits paying below the 4.5% policy rate. Safe VND rates: SBV refinancing rate 4.5%; 10-year government bond 4.58% (30 Oct 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 4.78% (2023); deposit interest is tax-exempt; current bank deposit rates are not cited (only bank rate sheets were readable).

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: SBV refinancing rate 4.5%; 10-year government bond yield 4.58%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case at the policy rate and just under the 10-year bond yield. Safe VND rates: SBV refinancing rate 4.5%; 10-year government bond 4.58% (30 Oct 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 4.78% (2023); deposit interest is tax-exempt; current bank deposit rates are not cited (only bank rate sheets were readable).

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: World Bank average deposit rate (FR.INR.DPST); 10-year government bond yield
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case for longer deposits at smaller banks, about a point above the policy rate. Safe VND rates: SBV refinancing rate 4.5%; 10-year government bond 4.58% (30 Oct 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 4.78% (2023); deposit interest is tax-exempt; current bank deposit rates are not cited (only bank rate sheets were readable).

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life insurance claim settlement ratio published by the Ministry of Finance insurance supervisor was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Pure term life cover is sold, but we found no published premium rates or credible premium guide in dong.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium rates found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)
oop_health_share.note: 39.2% for 2023, the latest World Bank value; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: NSO CPI health sub-index (via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_health.note: Health CPI rose 1.75% in the year to October 2026 because public fees are state-set, but private care costs rise faster, so we plan 1.5 points above the 4.5% general inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: NSO CPI education sub-index (via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education CPI rose 2.74% in the year to October 2026 after public school tuition waivers; private school fees rise faster, so we plan half a point above the 4.5% general inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.note: Men 70.4, women 79.6 (2026 estimate); secondary source. World Bank gives 74.7 for 2024.

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age (2026); secondary source.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL; UN WPP 2024 medium variant (via populationpyramid.net)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 14.0 in 2025 (World Bank), 23.6 in 2040 and 41.3 in 2065 (UN WPP 2024).

retirement_age_default.note: Men 61.5 and women 57 in 2026 (Trading Economics, citing the labour ministry); under the Labour Code 2019 roadmap people born after 1975 should retire at 62 (men) and 60 (women), but no readable official page confirming the final ages was found (law databases are script-rendered).

retirement_age_government.note: Public employees follow the same Labour Code roadmap: Men 61.5 and women 57 in 2026 (Trading Economics, citing the labour ministry); under the Labour Code 2019 roadmap people born after 1975 should retire at 62 (men) and 60 (women), but no readable official page confirming the final ages was found (law databases are script-rendered).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: SBV refinancing rate; short-term deposit rates
retirement_return_low.note: Low case for short deposits. Safe VND rates: SBV refinancing rate 4.5%; 10-year government bond 4.58% (30 Oct 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 4.78% (2023); deposit interest is tax-exempt; current bank deposit rates are not cited (only bank rate sheets were readable).

retirement_return_base.sourceName: SBV refinancing rate 4.5%; 10-year government bond yield 4.58%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case just under the 4.5% policy rate and the 4.58% 10-year yield, so it stays below the safe rate after tax. Safe VND rates: SBV refinancing rate 4.5%; 10-year government bond 4.58% (30 Oct 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 4.78% (2023); deposit interest is tax-exempt; current bank deposit rates are not cited (only bank rate sheets were readable).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: 10-year government bond yield; World Bank average deposit rate
retirement_return_high.note: High case for longer deposits a little above the bond yield. Safe VND rates: SBV refinancing rate 4.5%; 10-year government bond 4.58% (30 Oct 2026); World Bank average deposit rate 4.78% (2023); deposit interest is tax-exempt; current bank deposit rates are not cited (only bank rate sheets were readable).

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of VND deposits, bonds and equity funds
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% equity at the low case and 60% deposits and bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of VND deposits, bonds and equity funds
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half equity at 8.5% and half deposits and bonds near 4.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of VND deposits, bonds and equity funds
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% equity at the high case and 40% deposits and bonds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The 2024 Social Insurance Law added a social pension allowance for older people without a pension, but we could not read an official page giving the current monthly amount.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility ages and means test for the social pension allowance could not be confirmed from a readable official page.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code 2019 provides a severance allowance for years not covered by unemployment insurance, but we could not read the legal text to confirm the days per year.

public_pension_scheme.note: Vietnam Social Security runs compulsory and voluntary social insurance (pension age 61.5 for men and 57 for women in 2026), but the entry age, indexation and minimum years under the 2024 law could not be confirmed from a readable page.

fdr_3m.localName: Tiền gửi tiết kiệm có kỳ hạn

fdr_1y.localName: Tiền gửi tiết kiệm có kỳ hạn

dps.note: Offered by many banks; no published average rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury bills are rarely issued and not sold to individuals.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned to institutions; individuals can buy on the secondary market through securities firms.

tbond_10y.note: Auctioned to institutions; individuals can buy on the secondary market through securities firms.

equity_fund.note: Open-ended funds and ETFs tracking the VN-Index are sold to retail investors.

gold.note: Gold bars and rings are widely bought from licensed gold traders and banks.

insuranceRegulator.name: Ministry of Finance, Insurance Supervisory Authority

insuranceComplaints.name: Ministry of Finance, Insurance Supervisory Authority
insuranceComplaints.note: No insurance ombudsman; complaints go to the insurer, then the Ministry of Finance.

statistics.name: General Statistics Office (National Statistics Office), Ministry of Finance
